trailhead.label: Ville di Giovo (Piazza della Crosara), the APT’s start

cautions: Forest tracks and a short footpath; the tarred lane at the start is open to cars.
The viewpoint is at the edge of a cliff: keep your dog on a short lead there.
A steady climb of about 300 m.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
